abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered device did not provide a valid identifier.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Address and token verified. Settings saved; the integration is reloading.
abort.reauth_successful: Access restored. The integration is reloading.
abort.entry_not_found: This integration entry was removed. Close this form.
abort.missing_identity: The saved gateway has no device identity. Settings were not changed.
abort.entry_changed: Settings changed during validation. Open the form again.
abort.cloud_link_failed: The gateway could not be linked. Create a new code in SmartShev.

error.invalid_auth: The LAN token does not match the gateway. Copy this gateway's token from SmartShev.
error.missing_bearer: The gateway did not receive an authorization header. Check the address and direct access without a proxy.
error.auth_rejected: Access was refused without a specific reason. Check the gateway address and LAN token.
error.invalid_host: Enter the gateway IPv4 address or hostname. HTTP port 80 is used; no path, password or URL parameters.
error.token_required: Paste this gateway's LAN token from SmartShev.
error.wrong_device: A different gateway answered at this address. Settings were not changed.
error.invalid_pairing: This code expired or was already used. Create a new code.
error.device_access_denied: This gateway is no longer available via the cloud.
error.no_cloud_devices: This account has no gateways with remote access and the Full plan.
